zh.title: 被流放的英雄
zh.summary: 雪地逃生、战斗教学、两块鬼石与雪魈王。

en.title: The Banished Hero
en.summary: Escape the snowy opening, unlock the cart shortcut, and face the Snow Yeti King.

zh.title: 试炼雪山
zh.summary: 巨剑、长枪、刀斧三段试炼，三块鬼石与布雷德。

en.title: Trials of the Frozen Mountain
en.summary: Complete the greatsword, spear and axe trials before facing Blade.

zh.title: 被遗忘的神庙
zh.summary: 探索神庙机关，取得三块鬼石，击败蝰蛇。

en.title: Forgotten Temple
en.summary: Enter the temple, work through its mechanisms, and open the Viper arena.

zh.title: 复仇序章
zh.summary: 穿过村落与仓库，收集三块鬼石和“避难令”，挑战沃尔巴依诺。

en.title: First Act of Revenge
en.summary: Cross the village and warehouse, then unlock the cart shortcut before Volbaino.

zh.title: 可疑的恶臭
zh.summary: 探索矿山与毒沼，收集三块鬼石、铁匠工会许可证，挑战阿拉特拉。

en.title: Strange Stench
en.summary: Advance through the mine and poisonous swamp to Aratra.

zh.title: 叛徒的真面目
zh.summary: 穿过城区与城塞，收集四块鬼石，挑战朗格斯。

en.title: Traitor Revealed
en.summary: Cross the city and citadel, opening shortcuts before Rangkus.

zh.title: 刃指账幕
zh.summary: 穿过采石场与盗匪城塞，收集四块鬼石和间谍密信，挑战玛路卡。

en.title: Veiled Knives
en.summary: Traverse the quarry and bandit citadel before Maluca.

zh.title: 被吞噬的村庄
zh.summary: 从村落深入地下设施，收集四块鬼石与实验记录，挑战埃拉梅因。

en.title: Devoured Village
en.summary: Return behind the starting checkpoint, then descend through the village and underground facility.

zh.title: 无法相信的真相
zh.summary: 探索劳役场与矿洞，收集三块鬼石、尤利安项链，挑战沙克图卡。

en.title: Inconceivable Truth
en.summary: Search the labor facility and mine before Shactuka.

zh.title: 魔女之城
zh.summary: 穿过魔女之城，收集五块鬼石与圆盘碎片，挑战特萝卡。

en.title: Witch’s Castle
en.summary: Descend through the city and castle to Trokka.

zh.title: 隐士山脉
zh.summary: 穿越隐士山脉与传送区域，收集四块鬼石，挑战贝雷里安。

en.title: Hermit Mountains
en.summary: Cross the mountains, portals and phantom forest before Bellerian.

zh.title: 受诅咒者的要塞
zh.summary: 通过受诅咒的要塞，收集五块鬼石与圆盘碎片，挑战斯卡坡。

en.title: Corruptors’ Fortress
en.summary: Traverse the fortress, towers and bridges to Skalpel.

zh.title: 诡异的旋律
zh.summary: 探索剧院与传送画，收集四块鬼石和圆盘碎片，挑战伊莉娜。

en.title: Strange Melody
en.summary: Explore the theatre, falling floor and transport paintings before Ilyna.

zh.title: 帝国的末日
zh.summary: 穿越帝都旧城与教堂，收集五块鬼石，挑战狂龙赫斯。

en.title: Fall of the Empire
en.summary: Cross the imperial city, sewer and church to Hismar.

zh.title: 血染的圣所
zh.summary: 穿过血染的圣所，收集五块鬼石与莉丝档案，挑战莉丝。

en.title: Bloodied Sanctuary
en.summary: Climb through the sanctuary and beam sections before Reese.

zh.title: 混沌之主
zh.summary: 穿过皇宫与隐藏通道，收集四块鬼石，迎战奥兹玛。

en.title: Master of Chaos
en.summary: Cross the palace and hidden passage to Ozma.

zh.title: 斯顿雪域的斗鬼
zh.summary: 进入边界裂缝后，在任务传送界面选择挑战。

en.title: Spirit of the Ston Snowfield
en.summary: Select the challenge from the mission portal after reaching the Crevice.

zh.title: 罐子爱好者
zh.summary: 在据点接取罐子任务；完成后可回访前五章寻找罐子精灵。

en.title: Jar Enthusiast
en.summary: Accept the jar quest at the hub. Finishing it enables the early chapter Jarling revisits.

zh.title: 铁匠的传家宝
zh.summary: 与据点铁匠交谈，进入蜘蛛坟墓取回传家宝。

en.title: The Blacksmith’s Heirloom
en.summary: Speak to the blacksmith and return to the Spider Tomb.

zh.title: 悲惨之夜
zh.summary: 与达芙罗娜交谈接取。

en.title: Tragic Night
en.summary: Accept the mission from Daphrona.

zh.title: 寂静神庙
zh.summary: 与奥克萨娜交谈接取，完成后开放装备特性更改与继承。

en.title: Silent Temple
en.summary: Accept from Oksana to unlock gear modification and inheritance.

zh.title: 人类塞伦斯
zh.summary: 推进据点对话后，在任务列表选择人类塞伦斯。

en.title: Human Xilence
en.summary: Finish the hub conversations and select Human Xilence.

zh.title: 最后的讨伐
zh.summary: 在人类塞伦斯之后继续塞伦斯的任务线。

en.title: The Final Subjugation
en.summary: Continue Xilence’s mission chain after Human Xilence.

zh.title: 帕维尔的遗言
zh.summary: 完成被吞噬的村庄后，在任务传送界面选择。

en.title: Pavel’s Final Words
en.summary: Select the mission after Devoured Village.

zh.title: 为何要抛弃我们
zh.summary: 返回据点与特利斯坦交谈接取。

en.title: Why Did You Abandon Us
en.summary: Speak to Tristan at the hub after the main mission.

zh.title: 里侬矿山逃脱记
zh.summary: 完成前置支线后与尤利安对话接取。

en.title: Escaping Linon Mine
en.summary: Speak to Yulian after the preceding side mission.

zh.title: 最后的命令
zh.summary: 完成矿山救援、返回据点对话后继续任务线。

en.title: The Last Command
en.summary: Continue after the mine rescue and hub dialogue.

zh.title: 拉克里玛
zh.summary: 在新解锁的任务列表中选择，推进幽魂的成长。

en.title: Lacrima
en.summary: Select the newly unlocked mission to develop the Phantom.

zh.title: 窒息的单相思
zh.summary: 与特利斯坦交谈，调查莉迪亚的遭遇。

en.title: Unrequited Love
en.summary: Speak to Tristan and investigate Lydia’s fate.

zh.title: 巴鲁斯的斧头
zh.summary: 进入任务后先与巴鲁斯之子交谈。

en.title: Varus’s Axe
en.summary: Speak to Varus’s son at the beginning of the mission.

zh.title: 精准之亚特兰特
zh.summary: 与贝雷里安交谈接取。

en.title: Atlante the Precise
en.summary: Accept the mission from Bellerian.

zh.title: 猩红踪迹
zh.summary: 完成要塞主线并推进据点对话后选择此任务。

en.title: Crimson Trace
en.summary: Select the mission after the fortress and hub dialogue.

zh.title: 最后的护卫军
zh.summary: 与特利斯坦交谈，寻找西凡和维蒙。

en.title: The Last Guard
en.summary: Speak to Tristan to search for Sivan and Vimon.

zh.title: 超越者之剑
zh.summary: 继续后续支线，寻找布雷德的剑。

en.title: Transcendental Sword
en.summary: Continue the side missions to recover Blade’s sword.

zh.title: 百人敢死队
zh.summary: 完成剧院主线后选择此任务。

en.title: The Suicide Squad
en.summary: Select this mission after the theatre main quest.

zh.title: 残余的混沌
zh.summary: 返回据点与特利斯坦对话接取。

en.title: Residual Chaos
en.summary: Speak to Tristan at the hub.

zh.title: 抗命
zh.summary: 帮助尤利安寻找家人。

en.title: Disobedience
en.summary: Help Yulian find his family.

zh.title: 卡隆的锁链
zh.summary: 继续圣物相关任务，准备连续首领战。

en.title: Charon’s Chains
en.summary: Continue the relic mission and prepare for consecutive bosses.

zh.title: 恶的诞生
zh.summary: 与尤利安交谈接取。

en.title: The Birth of Evil
en.summary: Accept the mission from Yulian.

zh.title: 誓约
zh.summary: 集齐阿尔戴比勒、瓦尔萨勒、罗维利恩三块圆盘碎片后，与达芙罗娜推进对话。

en.title: The Vow
en.summary: Collect the Aldevir, Vaisar and Rovelion disc fragments, then speak to Daphrona.
